design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (difficulty edu_enrollment_payments_and_changes, M=2).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 5]}; edu_ext_verified_rate_of_pursuit takes 5 factors, edu_ext_flat_monthly_release takes 4. Task 1 draw (headroom check): prerequisite_problems 1, factor_counts [4, 6].
[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed here: edu_ext_verified_rate_of_pursuit (user tool verify_enrollment_month_96d675a6, event edu_enrollment_verified) and edu_ext_flat_monthly_release (agent tool release_monthly_benefit_payment_750f9b6a, event edu_monthly_benefit_payment). Left for task 1: entitlement restoration after an amendment (edu_entitlement_restored) and the irrevocable Post-9/11 election (edu_benefit_relinquished), a separate tree on another customer; housing, books and school-profile events stay unclaimed rather than reserved.
[Why a good test] A Chapter 30 student says only 'my September payment never came'. The agent must (1) see that September is unverified and that the release waits on the student's own verification, hand it over, and work out the rate of pursuit the student confirms (reduction timing with the one-time exclusion of the first credits dropped, a 12-week nonstandard resident term, an eight-week online term at a second school lying wholly inside the resident term), then (2) price the month: verified rate selects the three-quarter rate though the school stamped half time, the delimiting date 2026-08-06 has passed but a 2019 temporary total rating on the compensation award extends it 50 days, the entitlement ledger ran out on 2026-09-23, and the term began 2026-09-08. Difficulty is reading policy, reconciling 11 ledger charges and two certifications and a comp history, not picking tools.
[Design thesis] surface goal 'September payment' -> prerequisite sentence of edu_ext_flat_monthly_release: 'The monthly benefit for a month is fixed only after the certification carries the student's own verification entry for that month, because the rate of pursuit confirmed there is the one the month is paid at.' -> verification of September (user) with confirmed rate 98 -> monthly release 1007.20 for 16 days. Depth: 1 hop. Breadth: enrollment amendments, two certifications, ledger, payments, comp decisions.
[Problem-tree card] root edu_ext_flat_monthly_release; edge edu_ext_flat_monthly_release <- edu_ext_verified_rate_of_pursuit: kind value_input, gate verified_rop (and month_start), form state, policy_source 'The monthly benefit for a month is fixed only after the certification carries the student's own verification entry for that month, because the rate of pursuit confirmed there is the one the month is paid at.', condition 'The benefit's enrollment records carry a verification entry for the resident certification and the month being paid, with the rate of pursuit the student confirmed.', resolved_by verify_enrollment_month_96d675a6 (owner user). Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; waits on a record-visible state (a verification entry for the month on the certification); no tool/id/code token; hard requirement at the scope of the one month paid. Exactly one write of the difficulty creates verification entries (verify_enrollment_month_96d675a6), so the state form resolves to one action. Opening evidence: latest verification is initial_state.edu_enrollments.a6f97889-0b29-452c-9d4d-ab06c8d71631.verification_month = 2021-07 on the Summer 2021 certification; none for cd1da4c7-b5d1-4a96-823f-b9ec42b961f0. Topological order [edu_ext_verified_rate_of_pursuit, edu_ext_flat_monthly_release]. Deletion sensitivity (sens run skipping step 10): release recomputes 2518.00 (month 2021-07, rate 100) instead of 1007.20. user_scenario never mentions verification as missing; it only agrees to verify when handed over. Tools validate nothing: the release tool reads the certification only to copy references.
[Base-invariant card] verify_enrollment_month_96d675a6: edu_evt_monthly_verification.verify_once (dedup: one verification per certification and month) - no verification exists for (cd1da4c7-b5d1-4a96-823f-b9ec42b961f0, 2026-09); evidence rows 6514c202-d4da-43f5-ac47-98d1d0a8c9f1.source_enrollment_id = cd1da4c7-b5d1-4a96-823f-b9ec42b961f0, comp payment e2e9ba01-7bb0-4ca8-9606-fbe67e5037cc.payment_month = 2026-09 for the month key. release_monthly_benefit_payment_750f9b6a: edu_flat_rate_monthly.flat_month_verified - satisfied by prior_step 10 (verification entry correlated by source_enrollment_id = enrollment_id and verification_month = payment_month); edu_excl_chapter_election policy_scope - only Chapter 30 is held. No time-kind gates.
[Business-object card] Target: Fall 2026 resident certification cd1da4c7-b5d1-4a96-823f-b9ec42b961f0 (Austin Community College, 8 credits, 2026-09-08..2026-11-30), month 2026-09. Included: reduction 6514c202-d4da-43f5-ac47-98d1d0a8c9f1 (last date of attendance 2026-09-18, inside the term), distance-learning certification 6cdb9b0e-74d3-4528-98b7-d99c978b4552 (Texas State, 2026-09-08..2026-11-01, 4 credits), ledger charges (ten terms 2016-2021 = 1072 days + Fall 2026 charge 7f7a3ecc-e84a-4926-9cd9-1cf8096ff578 = 8 days ending 2026-09-23), comp decisions 20e1ba1d-10bc-4630-adc2-0752b051fc1e (temporary total from 2019-03-12) and b83288fc-d926-47f7-868c-cff73dc40923 (ended 2019-05-01). Excluded: 2021 verifications 25600ebb-9d7a-42f5-b35c-ac18f7e368c3,a6f97889-0b29-452c-9d4d-ab06c8d71631 and payments 1fa4f98b-8c66-4bc0-a79c-3f36746bea7b,b240c4e5-eb4b-472f-931d-99a8d367e117 (other certification and months), comp decision 86eb1d8d-e74a-41c5-a0eb-11b85c5cad7d (service connection, not a total rating), comp payments (no effect on the figures).
[Factor card edu_ext_verified_rate_of_pursuit] reduced_resident_credits tier 1 (last date of attendance inside the term) -> 2.7857 credits (baseline 8 -> 100); excused_credit_allowance tier 2 (no evidence accepted, first reduction ever) -> the 6 dropped credits up to the Chapter 30 one-time exclusion of 6 = 6 (baseline none -> 89); resident_term_measure 12 weeks -> 9 (baseline 12 -> 90); distance_learning_credits_added wholly inside -> 4 (baseline 0 -> 31); distance_learning_term_measure 7.9 weeks -> 6 (baseline 12 -> 64); whole baseline 8/12 = 67. Near-miss: the school's stamps on the certification (half_time, 67 percent) and the amendment (less_than_half_time, 17 percent) are measured on 12 credits and are never read; the 2016-2021 in-person certifications are not the latest.
[Factor card edu_ext_flat_monthly_release] verified_rate_paid 98 -> 1888.50 (baseline certified half_time 1259.00 -> 671.47); total_disability_extension (cross-difficulty comp, multi-source) 50 days (baseline 0 -> 0.00); entitlement_stop_day day 23, entitlement ran out before the middle of the term so no end-of-term extension (baseline 30 -> 1133.10); first_day_paid day 8 (baseline day 1 -> 1447.85); whole baseline 0.00 (the record's delimiting date alone stops payment before September). Overwrite declared: edu_evt_delimiting 'A term that straddles the delimiting date is paid only through that date.' replaced by the delimiting cut-off sentence with the extension (38 CFR 21.7051 extension for a period of disability). Near-miss: decision 86eb1d8d-e74a-41c5-a0eb-11b85c5cad7d raises the rating but is not a total rating; the comp award today is 30 percent without individual unemployability, so tier 2 does not apply.
[Seed design] Customer Terrence J. Whitfield (phone 5125550143, SSN4 3417, file 331408526, DOB 1990-03-08), Army 2012-08-07..2016-08-06. Chapter 30 status exhausted (1080 charged), delimiting 2026-08-06. Automatic clauses checked: delimiting transition (system) not applied because the extension is computed at payment; no unsettled payments; the reduction created no overpayment because nothing had been paid for the term; verification suspension irrelevant (first month of the term).
[Persona] Plain-spoken, tired; volunteers only the missing September payment and lets the representative act on its side; verifies only as a conditional reaction when the verification is handed over; identity, schools, the mid-September drop, the knee compensation and the account ending 6621 only when asked; verifies by phone when handed over; ends when told the payment was issued.
[Standard solution] locate by phone -> verify identity (3417, 331408526, 1990-03-08) -> read benefit, enrollments, ledger, payments, comp award, decisions and payments -> hand over verification (verify_enrollment_month_96d675a6: cd1da4c7-b5d1-4a96-823f-b9ec42b961f0, 2026-09, phone, 98) -> release (release_monthly_benefit_payment_750f9b6a: cd1da4c7-b5d1-4a96-823f-b9ec42b961f0, 2026-09, 16, 1007.20).
[Verification run] .venv/bin/python /tmp sensitivity script on tasks/0.json: edu_ext_verified_rate_of_pursuit result 98, factor baselines 100/89/90/31/64, all-baseline 67; edu_ext_flat_monthly_release result 1007.2, factor baselines 671.47/0.0/1133.1/1447.85, all-baseline 0.0; skipping step 10 gives 2518.0. check_compute recomputes the same.
[Draft from visible context] From the KB prose of both policies, the finders' returns and the persona: September unverified -> student verifies (only action that creates the entry) -> rate 98 -> three-quarter rate, 16 days -> 1007.20; no second reading found (the reduction sentence fixes the averaging over the term's days; the overlap sentence fixes both-ends counting).
[Closure] policies {PA, PB} = computations = required_documents; tools [verify_enrollment_month_96d675a6, release_monthly_benefit_payment_750f9b6a] in first-call order; write order follows the edge.
[Revision round 2 - policy-task audit] O1: overwrite now also retires edu_evt_delimiting 'A benefit with a delimiting date pays nothing for training after that date' and 'The delimiting date of Chapter 30 runs delimiting_years years from the last release from active duty.' (replaced by the delimiting cut-off and extension sentences), so the base reading 0.00 is no longer in force. O2: overwrite retires edu_flat_rate_monthly 'Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606 pay the student a flat monthly rate by training time' (replaced by 'The rate paid follows the rate of pursuit confirmed on the student's most recent verification'), and the release rule now calls the fall-through 'the training time recorded', so 671.47 is no longer a defensible answer. O4: a term cut-off (day the resident term ends, or the 30th) now bounds the days payable, in the rule, the baseline paragraph and compute (term_cut = 30 here). R3: entitlement_stop_day now carries a tier the base never stated (entitlement running out after the middle of a term is paid to the term end) and overwrite retires the base 'while a flat-rate chapter stops paying on the day entitlement runs out'; this world sits on the tier 'no more than half of the term passed' (16 of 84 days), so the status/closed_date stamp alone no longer tells the cut-off. R2: the Texas State eight-week session now runs 2026-09-08..2026-11-01, wholly inside the resident term and covering all of September; the verified rate of pursuit is 98 (was 82) and the payment stays at the three-quarter rate, 1007.20. C1: the persona's unconditional 'willing to verify your enrollment yourself' was removed; the verification is now only the conditional reaction to the hand-over, and the contract cites that line. F1/O3: the excused-credit ladder no longer has a second-reduction allowance: first reduction dropping no more than 6 -> every dropped credit, first reduction dropping more than 6 -> 6, any earlier reduction -> none (the one-time exclusion). Re-run: verify 98 (baselines 100/89/90/31/64, all 67); release 1007.20 (671.47/0.00/1133.10/1447.85, all 0.00); skipping the verification still gives 2518.00.
[Revision round 3 - policy-task audit revision_2] F6: the excused-credit ladders were one treatment in two tiers (up to 6 credits either way). The exclusion is now sized as six semester hours or the equivalent on the term's own full-time measure: first reduction on a term measured on 6 credits -> 3, on 9 credits -> 4.5, on the full-time standard -> 6; any earlier reduction -> none. These are three distinct figures plus the fall-through. On this world the resident term is measured on 9 credits, so 4.5 of the 6 dropped credits are excused (the full-time-standard tier would excuse 6 and give 98). Verified rate of pursuit now 95 (sensitivities 100/89/90/29/62, all-baseline 67); release unchanged at 1007.20 (three-quarter band). Observations closed: compute_basis res_start/res_training_time now quote 'the training time recorded'; the verified_rate_paid fall-through reads 'no verification on file, or the most recent verification confirms 0 percent' -> 'the rate for the training time recorded'; the rule now states that with no verification on file at all the day of the call stands in for the first day of the month paid.
[Revision round 4 - policy-task audit revision_3] F7 / O5: the term-length-scaled exclusion (3 / 4.5 / 6) is gone. The excused credits now follow VA practice and the base sentence 'the first mitigating_excused_credits credit hours a student ever drops are accepted as mitigating without evidence': mitigating circumstances accepted on the student's evidence -> every dropped credit; no evidence, first reduction ever -> the credits dropped up to the tier's one-time mitigating_excused_credits (6 on Chapter 30, read with P()); no evidence after an earlier reduction -> none. The three outcomes differ whenever more than 6 credits are dropped (all vs 6 vs 0), so F6 stays closed; no override of the base exclusion remains, so O3/O5 are closed. reduced_resident_credits now ladders on the timing of the last date of attendance (inside the term -> excused credits through it, remaining after; reduction for the term with the last date of attendance before the term start -> remaining credits for the whole term; otherwise certified). On this world the first reduction drops 6 credits, all excused: verified rate of pursuit 98 (base reading 98, no second value); sensitivities 100/89/90/31/64, all-baseline 67; release unchanged 1007.20.
[Revision round 6 - KB audit, policy-side item PS-0] The entitlement-restoration policy (task 1's) would have applied to this world's reduction (8-day Fall 2026 charge, no restoration entry). A rollout booking it before the release would have moved the entitlement cut-off and paid 18 days. Its rule now gives entitlement back only once the reduced term has ended and its enrollment is final; this resident term runs to 2026-11-30, after today, so no restoration is due here (the restoration compute evaluates to 0 on this world). The solution stays verification 98 then release 16 days / 1007.20, and the release's entitlement cut-off (ledger 0 remaining, last charged day 2026-09-23) is unaffected.
user_scenario: You are Terrence J. Whitfield, a 36-year-old Army veteran in Austin, Texas, using the Montgomery GI Bill (Chapter 30). You are calling because your September GI Bill payment never showed up in your bank account. You are tired and a little embarrassed to be asking about money, so you keep it short and polite, and you speak plainly without any VA jargon. Open by saying something like: "Hi, my September GI Bill payment never came, and I need to find out what happened and get it sent." You want the September payment released to you today if it is owed, and you are fine with the representative doing whatever they need to do on their end. If the representative asks how to find you, give your phone number, 5125550143. When they ask you to verify your identity, give the last four of your Social Security number, 3417, your VA file number, 331408526, and your date of birth, 1990-03-08, one at a time as they ask. Only if asked about school do you explain that this fall you are in a 12-week session at Austin Community College and also taking an online class through Texas State University in an eight-week session that started the same week, and only if asked whether anything changed do you say you dropped two of your Austin Community College classes in the middle of September and kept the rest. If asked about other VA benefits, you say you get disability compensation for your right knee; you do not remember the details of any rating decisions and tell them to look at the record. If asked which account the money goes to, it is the checking account ending in 6621. You do not know what a rate of pursuit is, how VA counts your classes, or how much the payment should be, and you never guess a figure. When the representative tells you that you need to verify September yourself and hands that over to you, you do it right there on the phone; if they read back a percentage or an enrollment figure and ask you to confirm it, you say yes, that is what you are taking, and you go ahead with the verification. If they ask whether you want them to go ahead and release the payment, you say yes, please. Once the representative tells you the September payment has been issued, you thank them, say you will watch your account, and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's VA profile by the telephone number he gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs the beneficiary's reference number; the caller is identified only by what he can state.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with three items he states (SSN last four, VA file number, date of birth).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be verified before any benefit, payment or entitlement detail is discussed or changed.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Chapter 30 benefit: status, entitlement granted and remaining, delimiting date 2026-08-06, establishment date, payment method.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The delimiting date and the establishment date feed the delimiting cut-off and the temporary-total test; the benefit reference number selects every later read.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every certification, amendment and verification on the benefit: the Fall 12-week resident certification (8 credits, 2026-09-08 to 2026-11-30), the reduction to 2 credits with last date of attendance 2026-09-18 and no mitigating circumstances, the Texas State distance-learning certification (4 credits, eight-week session 2026-09-08 to 2026-11-01), the absence of any September 2026 verification, and the older 2021 verifications.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the month is unverified (the prerequisite of the monthly release) and supplies every input of the rate of pursuit: reduction timing, excused-credit allowance (first reduction ever), both term lengths and whether the distance-learning term lies wholly inside the resident term.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every entitlement charge on the benefit: ten earlier terms totalling 1072 days and the Fall 2026 charge of 8 days covering 2026-09-08 to 2026-09-23.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The ledger shows the entitlement is fully used (1080 granted, 1080 charged, nothing restored) and that the last charged day is 2026-09-23, the entitlement cut-off.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the monthly payments on the benefit: only the June and July 2021 payments; nothing for September 2026.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms no September 2026 payment exists, so the release is a first payment for the month and not a duplicate.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the caller's compensation award: 30 percent, running, effective 2019-05-01, no individual unemployability.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The award's current rating and unemployability status decide which tier of the delimiting extension applies.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the rating decisions: the temporary total rating effective 2019-03-12 and the decision effective 2019-05-01 that brought the rating down from 100 percent.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: These two decisions give the temporary total period (50 days) that extends the delimiting date.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the compensation payments for August and September 2026: 552.47 a month, the 30 percent rate.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the award is paid at its schedular 30 percent rate today, not at the total rate, so the delimiting extension comes from the ended temporary total period and not from a current total rating.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.rate_of_pursuit_pct: Value 98 (calculated by edu_ext_verified_rate_of_pursuit). Resident credits: reduction 8 -> 2 with last date of attendance 2026-09-18 inside the term; VA did not accept mitigating circumstances on evidence and this is the first reduction ever reported, so the 6 dropped credits are excused up to the Chapter 30 one-time exclusion of the first 6 credit hours a student ever drops (all 6): (2+6) x 11 days + 2 x 73 days over 84 = 2.7857. Resident measure: 84 days = 12 weeks -> 9. Distance learning: the Texas State term 2026-09-08 to 2026-11-01 lies wholly inside the resident term -> all 4 credits added, measured on its 55 days = 7.9 weeks -> 6. 2.7857/9 + 4/6 = 0.9762 -> 98 (half up, not above 100).

edges.condition: The benefit's enrollment records carry a verification entry for the resident certification and the month being paid, with the rate of pursuit the student confirmed.
edges.policy_source: The monthly benefit for a month is fixed only after the certification carries the student's own verification entry for that month, because the rate of pursuit confirmed there is the one the month is paid at.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: No verification entry exists for the Fall 2026 resident certification or for September 2026; the only verifications on the benefit are for June and July 2021 on the Summer 2021 certification.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The student's verification at step 10 creates an edu_enrollment_verified entry for the resident certification with verification_month 2026-09 and rate_of_pursuit_pct 98; the release then reads month 2026-09 and verified rate 98.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single edge: the verification must precede the release because the release reads the verification's month and rate. Replaying the release first (verification skipped) gives 2518.00 for the month 2021-07 read from the old verification, not 1007.20, so the order is forced by the prerequisite sentence.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the verification leaves the latest verification at 2021-07 with rate 100: the release computes month 2021-07, full-time rate 2518.00 over 30 days = 2518.00 instead of 1007.20, and the September verification row is missing from the terminal state.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only for the missing September payment and authorises the representative to act on its side; the verification appears only as a conditional reaction ('When the representative tells you that you need to verify September yourself and hands that over to you, you do it'), so the customer never names the verification before the agent has derived it, and never mentions rates of pursuit, the delimiting date, the knee surgery's temporary total rating or the entitlement balance.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: release_monthly_benefit_payment_750f9b6a only reads the certification to copy its benefit and customer reference and then creates the payment with the arguments given; it never looks for a verification, an entitlement balance or a delimiting date and returns status issued whether or not the month was verified.
